title: debark signature v1
description: debark.signature/v1 - the detached signature file for a manifest: one or more signature blocks over the manifest's canonical bytes. Written as debark.manifest.sig beside debark.manifest.json. verify recomputes manifest_sha256 from the manifest's canonical encoding and refuses a mismatch before it looks at any signature.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the manifest's canonical JSON bytes that were signed.

signatures.description: One or more independent signature blocks over the same manifest bytes.

signer_kind.description: Which Signer implementation produced this block: ed25519-file, gpg, sigstore, or plugin:<name> for an out-of-process signer.

key_id.description: Identifies the signing key: the base64 key id for ed25519-file, the uppercase fingerprint for gpg.

created_at.description: When this signature was produced, RFC 3339 UTC, second precision.

signature.description: Standard base64 of the raw signature bytes (for gpg: base64 of the detached binary signature).

comment.description: Optional operator text, e.g. "release engineering key, 2026".
